author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
I'm sorry everyone but I'll be leaving to go to Hawaii for a week to meet my dad who was deployed there. I'll miss you all!!!!!!!!! I'm leaving on Sunday at noon pst. I'll stay connected on skype. Add me if u want to talk: Skype = Sethskye.



From Seth
